To measure the quality of texts under the attacks that change the semantic meaning ... we utilize Perplexity ... and MAUVE. For the editing attacks, we use Levenshtein Edit Distance as the major budget ... Additionally, we also record Jaro Similarity. For paraphrasing ... we use BERTScore ... we also record BARTScore and Cosine Similarity.
We utilize a series of text generation evaluation metrics as the budget of attacks, covering syntactic-or semantic-level perturbation.
